data.name: COMBO: Sunset and Manta Ray Snorkel
data.headline: Sail into sunset, snorkel with manta rays
data.description:
**Join us for Kona's #1 marine encounter!**

Start your adventure by watching one of our legendary Kona sunsets as we sail along the Kona coast to our snorkel destination (Manta Ray Village).  

Once we arrive at the snorkel location, receive a full safety briefing before joining our guides in the water to snorkel with the majestic hahalua (manta rays).  

Afterwards, join us back on the boat for hot cocoa, and hot tea enjoying the lights of Kona town as we make our back to the pier.

Because the manta rays are wild animals, we also offer one of the best manta guarantees in the industry.  If you go out with us and do not see a manta ray, we will rebook you again for free (subject to availability, does not apply to "ride along" guests).
data.highlights:
- Beautiful sail along the Kona coast during sunset 
- Approximately 30 minutes of snorkel time with the majestic manta rays
- Unlimited non-alcoholic beverages
- Post snorkeling hot cocoa and hot tea
- Our “grand staircase” which allow for easy water enter/exit (no ladders to climb)
- Reduced “ride along” rate for those guests that will not be getting in the water
- Beautiful lights of Kona town

data.cancellation_notes:
#Cancellations / Rebookings
Customers will receive a full refund provided cancellations are made **at least 48 hours prior to scheduled departure time (7 days for private charters).***Cancellations within 48 hours of scheduled departure time, no shows or guests that check-in late and miss the tour will NOT be refunded.***  Additionally, guests that reschedule their tour within 48 hours of scheduled departure time (7 days for private charters) will be subject to a rebooking fee.  Customers will receive a full refund in case of *Operator cancellations* due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.

#Manta Ray Guarantee
***Please be advised that manta rays are wild animals and WE DO NOT OFFER REFUNDS to guests that join us on a manta ray snorkel and do not see manta rays.*** In the event you go out with us on a manta ray snorkel and do not see manta rays, we will attempt to rebook you on another night for free (subject to availability).  We always recommend that guests book this experience as early in their stay as possible, so that in the unlikely event you do not see a manta ray, we do have the ability to try and rebook you on another evening.  The manta guarantee for rebooking does *not* apply to "ride-along" guests that stay on the boat.

**75-5660 Palani Road, Suite C8, Kailua-Kona, HI 96740**

**All guests getting into the water MUST KNOW HOW TO SWIM WITHOUT THE ASSISTANCE OF A FLOTATION DEVICE. ***REMEMBER TO BRING THE FOLLOWING:***
-  *TOWEL* 
-  *SWIMSUIT*
-  *SUN PROTECTION (such as a hat and sunglasses)*
-  *Underwater camera or gopro*
-  *Anti nausea medication (if you are prone to sea/motion sickness)*
-  *We have ample space on board to store any personal belongings such as a small bag or backpack if you wish to bring one.* 

***USE OF FULL-FACE SNORKEL MASKS***
Please be advised that due to safety reasons, we do NOT allow the use of full-face snorkel masks on any of our tours

***Please Note: Our full bar onboard is cashless. We accept all major credit cards and tap pay for your convenience***

For guests that will be joining us on a tour and wish to park at the Courtyard Marriott King Kamehameha Hotel, located at **75 5660 Palani Road, Kailua-Kona, HI 96740**, they do receive a discounted rate of $13 per vehicle for the entire day. ***INTERNATIONAL PHONE NUMBERS***

data.faqs:
- What Is Parking Like?

Parking in Kona town can be challenging, especially during peak travel seasons.  We do offer validated parking for our guests that wish to park at the Courtyard Marriott King Kamehameha Kona Beach Hotel. The parking fee is $13 for the day. For those guests that wish to take advantage of this option, please bring your parking ticket and pay the validation fee at our store during check-in. There is also a free municipal parking lot located on Kuakini Hwy. From the municipal parking lot, head to Alii Drive and turn right. We are located at the Courtyard Marriott King Kamehameha Beach Hotel and Resort adjacent to the pool and the fitness center.

- Where Do I Check-In for My Kona Tour?

Check-in is at our KONASTYLE retail store.

- What Time Should I Check In for the Kona Snorkel Tour?

Please check-in 30 minutes prior to your scheduled departure time.

- What Do I Bring With Me?

Guests should bring their swimsuits, towels, reef-safe sunscreen and additional sun protection, such as a hat and sunglasses. There is plenty of space on the Kona Style catamaran, so guests are welcomed to bring backpacks or bags to store their personal items. If guests have their own snorkel equipment, they are welcomed to bring that as well. We also carry multiple sets of snorkel equipment that guests can use if they do not have their own.

- Can I Bring My Camera?

Yes. We get incredible views of the Kona coastline and we regularly see whales (seasonal) and dolphins, so cameras are highly recommended. We also offer waterproof cell phone cases for purchase at our check-in location.

- Do I Need to Bring a Towel With Me?

Yes

- Are Kids Welcome on the Tour?

Yes.  We offer youth rates (ages 5-12) and infant/child rates (age 4 and under).  Please be advised that only children ages 5 and above are allowed in the water and must know how to swim without the assistance of a floatation device.  If children are just riding along on the boat (not going in the water), we do require that one parent/guardian remain with their child on the vessel at all times.  If the parents/guardians would like to rotate (i.e. – one in the water while the other stays on board with the child), we are always happy to accommodate.

- Will My Things Get Wet?

While there is ample dry storage on the vessel, there is always a possibility that what you bring aboard may get wet. If you have valuable electronics that you will be bringing on board with you, we always recommend placing them in drybags or in Ziploc bags when not in use.

- Will I Have Cell Phone Service?

For most of our tours, there is cell phone service. However, in and around Kealakekua Bay guests should expect limited to no cell phone service in that area.
